title: CapabilityStatusV0
description: Machine-readable programme-truth record for one capability. Headline status is derived; do not store percent_complete. See docs/architecture/observatory.md.

id.description: Stable capability id (e.g. calendar.read, assist.propose, polaris.search).

ticket_ids.description: Owning tickets. Status is not copied from ticket Status fields without evidence.

hard.description: Capability ids that demote this headline when unmet.

last_verified.description: Clock of the newest successful VERIFIED or probe evidence. Absent means never.

notes.description: Author-side reminder. Not a status override.

held.description: Derived, not a mood. True only when evidence_refs are sufficient for this rung. Implementations MUST reject held=true when evidence_refs is empty. No percent_complete field exists.

evidence_refs.description: Ticket paths, test paths, CI run URLs, or probe ids. Empty ⇒ held must be false.
